blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 30.4.1 shuru karti hai. Is hisse mein ¹H NMR spectrum parhna seekhenge: 30.4.1 mein low-resolution spectrum (peaks ki tadaad, jagah aur area), 30.4.2 mein high-resolution spectrum aur peaks ka batna (splitting), aur 30.4.3 mein D₂O ki madad se O-H aur N-H protons ki pehchan.

blocks.prompt: ¹H NMR spectrum ki kaun si qism parosi (neighbouring) protons ki wajah se peaks ka batna dikhati hai?

items: Low resolution: peaks ki tadaad, chemical shift aur area.
High resolution: peaks ka batna (n + 1 rule).
D₂O shake: O-H aur N-H protons ki pehchan.
